description: The communication layer between people and robots, and between robots. Talk to any robot in your own words, with an LLM for its brain. Robots that have never met check each other's passports and share the work. Microduck, Huebot, Open Duck Mini, LeRobot arms, XLeRobot carts, AlohaMini, ToddlerBot, MOSS, ROS bases and industrial arms on ROS 2.
summary: 🦆🧠 Give your small robot a brain. Tell a Microduck, an Open Duck Mini you built yourself, a Reachy Mini, a LeRobot arm or any ROS base what you want in human language. An LLM (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, or a local model via Ollama, vLLM or llama.cpp) uses the skills it already has. Simulator, .du
